music.selection: Uniform random from three only when first loading; chosen player loops indefinitely. No per-level song rotation.

variant_selection: Per-group deterministic round robin, initially 1; (previous % count) + 1. fn#12068, hasm443153–443187, decompiled328035–328049/329052.
limitations: Decompiler generator locals are imperfect; crucial random/loop/reuse and variant claims also checked against Hermes assembly.
Audio assets include shared shell and other gameplay families. Asset presence and registration do not prove Inkomino main-line usage.

No original actual call found outside audio registration for ui_tap, popup_open/close, timer_tick, freeze_cast/end, life_lose/gain, continue_offer. Binding these is reconstruction behavior, not confirmed original timing.
Main-line win/fail use generic win/fail, not PM level_win/level_fail.
